description: lib.rs:1326,1334,2192,2364,2378,2473,2501,2559 — twelve for-loops use .iter() on slices/vecs where the bare reference suffices. Clippy pedantic explicit_iter_loop fires. Fix: replace `for x in v.iter()` with `for x in &v` (or `for x in v` if Vec). Pure style, no functional impact.
title: [rusty/pkix-path] explicit_iter_loop: .iter() in for loops
